summary: A prior hypothesis call was retained but excluded after its serialized input contained a fixture-oracle field. The exact protected value is omitted. A later clean call was qualified.
observed_outcome: The contaminated invocation did not qualify as evidence; the record was preserved for audit.
limitations: Historical evidence of an input-boundary failure, not a general rate estimate.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 within demonstrated scope and explicitly requested permanent retention of this rejected experiment.

summary: One local structured review response was malformed at a 700-token output cap. It was not used as a verdict; a later bounded review succeeded.
observed_outcome: Malformed output is retained as a failed attempt, not silently retried for a favorable result.
limitations: The provider body, exact output count, and token usage for the failed response were unavailable.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 within demonstrated scope and called out this failure as a research opportunity.

summary: The local inference provider reported token counts but no monetary cost. The cost remains null/unknown; unknown is not zero.
observed_outcome: No monetary savings claim was made from the local call.
limitations: Provider token counts do not establish billable cost.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 within demonstrated scope.

summary: A four-record status-label fixture improved agreement from 0.0 to 1.0. The result qualified only a fixture policy and did not establish operational effectiveness.
limitations: The fixture set was small and contained no independent system-level task outcomes.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 only within the demonstrated experimental scope.

summary: A candidate that declares additional compute receives an inconclusive result when no compute-matched control exists; the gain is not attributed to policy alone.
observed_outcome: The P6 deterministic control checked attribution limits.
limitations: This was a deterministic control, not a live resource-matched model comparison.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 within demonstrated scope.

summary: The first experience retriever uses bounded lexical overlap. It retrieved one relevant case and excluded a clearly unrelated query, but that does not qualify semantic relevance.
observed_outcome: P8 and P9 lexical retrieval controls passed.
limitations: No independently labeled relevance set or semantic retrieval comparison was used.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 and explicitly identified experience value as an open research question.

summary: STN06 is an eight-task held-out coding-transfer plan. Its model experiment remains NOT RUN until separate approval gates are met.
observed_outcome: The plan and preregistration were preserved; no completed model result is claimed.
limitations: It measures coding-task transfer, not investigation-hypothesis quality.
review_basis: The source plan itself distinguishes planned work from execution evidence.

summary: The prior deterministic controls reject evaluator-digest tampering and candidate evidence drift.
observed_outcome: P3 and P7 negative controls reject the altered candidate.
limitations: These are fixture tests, not operational governance enforcement.
review_basis: Owner accepted S0-S7 within demonstrated scope.
